main_text.l: Cor si luminibus queat videri,Cor non lumina certius viderent.Sic constantia firma cordi virtque,Sic candor macula carens, nitorisSic lux perspicui, nihil doli intusCelans, omnia denique aqua praeterVnam durissem, desiv secundumHic gradus mihi fortis est fauentis,Talem Heroida quod videre sperem,Qualem spes mihi nulla erat videndi,Antiqua Domina semel relicta.O si fors mihi faxit, utriusqueNectam ut corda adamantina catena,Quam nec suspicio, aemulatione,Liuorve, aut odium, aut seneCta soluat:Tam beatior omnibus lapillis,Tam sim clarior omnibus lapillis,Tam sim carior omnibus lapillis,Quam sum durior omnibus lapillis.

page.notes: Verse lines were run together by the transcriber into one paragraph with line breaks; the lower part of the page is faded and some words are uncertain, notably "Vnam durissem", "desiv secundum", "seneCta" and "aqua praeter". The lower half of the page shows only faint show-through, which is not transcribed.
